input.summary: Ported saxpy.cu to idiomatic SYCL 2020 in sycl/saxpy.cpp. It has no dpct helpers, no DPCT macros and no dpct includes; it uses sycl::queue with enable_profiling, sycl::malloc_shared/sycl::free, a range<1> parallel_for, and event profiling for kernel_ms. It compiles with icpx -fsycl (0 warnings, add_dpct_include=false) to build/candidate. Numerical check against a plain C++ reference: for n=1048576 the max abs diff is 4.77e-7, and for n=1000003 it is also 4.77e-7 with 0 elements above 1e-6. Both are within atol 1e-6. The outputs are not bitwise identical (likely FMA contraction in the device compile), but the tolerance is met. The "exit 1" results in the logs came from my cmp bitwise check, not from the port.
